data.name: McpAboutDescription
data.value:
MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers add tools to the assistant, such as searching the web, reading files or working with other applications.
Each connected server appears as a plug icon next to the built-in tools when you chat, switched off until you turn it on.
Servers started with npx need Node.js, and servers started with uvx need uv.
